title: ci(timing gates): the two timing steps report-only on every event, `schedule` included — the per-package wall ceiling and the shard drift stay readings, never a red (#22949 ruling E, item 1)
body:
Protects: `Test Core` on `main`'s hourly `schedule` run (the full battery under objectstack#22998), red three of four hours since C2 on a measurement of runner load; and every seat that reads a main-red as a package regression.

Filed by the director seat (summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`) on the maintainer's word 「22949 同意」 (2026-10-12) to this seat's letter E on #22949 (the ruling record is the newest `Ruling:` comment there). Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. ⛔ Not a claim. `.github/workflows/**` is governed in this repository as of #23048 (in flight) and by the round's posture: the PR stays a draft until a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` member approves it.

## What to build
1. `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` / `scripts/check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs`: the grading mode becomes report-only on every event (`TIMING_GRADED_EVENT` removed or set so that no event grades; `timingGateMode` returns `report` for every event and still refuses a missing `--event`, the dev picks the spelling whose self-test is the clearest); a package over its ceiling or a shard past its drift bound prints the same table and one `::warning::` annotation and exits 0 on `schedule` too. A refusal (a malformed table or raise record, a missing `--event`) stays red everywhere (ACCEPT 6119677604's decision).
2. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: the two steps ("Check this shard's timing drift" `:1136`, "Check the per-package suite-duration ceilings" `:1563`) keep their names, their `--event "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"` and the ⛔ at `:1076` (no `if:`, no `continue-on-error`); their comments say why no event grades (this ruling).
3. The headers of both scripts carry the ruling URL and the diagnosis in two sentences (density, not code). Untouched: the formula, `CEILING_FLOOR_SECONDS`, `RULED_CEILING_RAISES`, the dataset, the refresh lane (E2 is its own card).
4. Self-tests: every event → report; the existing graded-mode cases become the report-mode cases; the refusal cases unchanged.

## Acceptance
- `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs --self-test` and `partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test` exit 0; the parity checkers named in ACCEPT 6119677604 green unchanged; the first hourly `schedule` run on `main` after landing: the two steps green with their `::warning::` annotations where a package is over; #23007 closed on the ruling.

Related: #22949 (ruling E) · #22998 · #16468 · #22917 · #23007 · E2 (the refresh diff card, filed in the same act).
